newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SAfrica court approves Hollard, Crusader life deal.
newsitem.headline: SAfrica court approves Hollard, Crusader life deal.

text.p: The Pretoria High Court on Tuesday sanctioned the more than 18.5 million rand acquisition of Crusader Life Assurance Corp Ltd by Hollard Insurance Co Ltd.

"We are extremely pleased that this transaction has been sanctioned by the High Court after many months of negotiation. Crusader policyholders and employees now have a secure future with Hollard," manging director Peter Laburn said in a statement.
Laburn dismissed recent speculation that Hollard Life would be listed under the Crusader Life shell.
"Hollard is currently negotiating with another party to introduce new Life business opportunities into the Crusader shell," he said.
If the talks were successful and it was decided to retain the listing, minority shareholders would receive a preferential opportunity to buy shares in the new venture at the same cost as Hollard.
In terms of the acquisition, all Crusader's businesses will be transferred to Hollard Life, except the Equity Linked Life Annuity business which will be placed with Southern Life.
Laburn said the firm would pay 18 million rand for all Crusader's preference shares and 0.5 million rand for the ordinary shares.
Hollard is one of South Africa's largest independent insurance groups with combined assets of nearly one billion rand.
Crusader had been placed under provisional curatorship in 1993 and also placed under judicial management.
